working_definition: Nuclei of the authors' 'muscle' cluster(s) (Calderon et al. 2022), embryos 0-18 h.

best_match.fbbt_definition: In contrast to vertebrates, in Drosophila embryos and larva, each muscle is a single myotube (Maqbool and Jagla, 2007). Somatic, contractile cell that makes up a muscle. It is formed by several fusion events between fusion competent myoblasts and one founder cell.

justification: The authors' annotation 'muscle'. The authors do not say somatic or visceral muscle.
recommendation: Map to FBbt:00005074 muscle cell (broad match).
